contents.role: The pattern, taught end to end for an agent reader: step-zero handle discipline, the shared job, coordinator and worker playbooks, wrap discipline, accounting.
Agent-facing entry point: what this package makes you able to do and the 5-minute path from reading to a running swarm.
Runnable coordinator: opens the shared job, picks contributions up, verifies them from the record, wraps the swarm.
Runnable worker: contributes one piece under the shared job id, remembers the finding, wraps it as a handover to the coordinator.
No-code standing instructions for a coordinator chat agent.
No-code standing instructions for a worker chat agent.
Proof: the record of a real four-agent run on the live endpoint (2026-11-02), with every receipt and handover link.

description: Agent package: learn swarm coordination from the skill inside, then run a coordinated multi-agent job on Zambo in one step. One coordinator, one caller handle per worker, work moved as handovers, every contribution verified from its receipt, one handover as the deliverable.
free_tier: Per agent, keyed to its own caller handle: 20 calls + 1 wrap-up free every day; picking up a handover is always free. Day Pass $0.99 per agent, unlimited 24 hours. Zambo Pass $29 per agent, 30 days. One-time payments, never subscriptions.
name: zambo-swarm-coordination
positioning: Zambo is the shared work layer under a swarm (shared jobs, per-agent memory, handovers, verifiable receipts). It is not an orchestrator or framework: it does not schedule, spawn, or supervise agents.
